refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: SilikoLexer *SilikoLexerCreate( SilikoInput *source, bool support_dice, bool support_constants);

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoLexerNew` function creates a new `SilikoLexer` object.
* `InputSource` is the data source that will be used for input. The lexer will take ownership of the `SilikoDataSource` and call `SilikoDataSourceDeleve` on the object when the lexer is finished with the data source.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoLexerNew` returns a pointer to a new `SiikoLexer` object if there was no memory error. `SilikoLexerNew` returns `NULL` if there was a memory error.
